Eddie Johnson on twitter responding to Steve Kerr saying Steph’s injury limits the impact Draymond green can have on offense

“Name me a Potential Hall Of Fame player that will have that statistical personal Resume going into the Hall.   Then you have players like Mark Aquirre, Tom Chambers, Shawn Marion, and Kevin Johnson not get in?”

Draymond responding to Eddie Johnson: Hahaha you named a bunch of players not named Eddie 🤣🤣🤣. Making it me vs them not changing your life Ed

Eddie responding to Draymond: My life is good, Draymond. Thanks for checking🙏🏿 I named Aguirre, Chambers, Marion and KJ for a reason. Your defense and impact on winning are part of your case. So here’s the individual basketball question. How do you weigh that against the individual résumés of those four guys who could actually carry a team if the star player they played with is injured?  Check my resume, even I did that many times.  I got more players for you if you want?  Just doing my job bro as an analyst. Isn’t that your main job now and basketball is only when Curry plays?
